title: skills(pm-dispatch): governed treatment travels with an instruction file, the execution seat stays with the landing repo's lane
body:
Fixes #18518

Clause-②: no

## What changed

One governed rules-layer line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — the ACCEPT path-fork's governed-face definition row (:607 on `ab1d35925`, anchored on its text) — is re-keyed in place so that reading (i) of 「跨仓同判」 is the written one: the governance TREATMENT travels with an agent instruction file wherever it lives; the execution SEAT does not.

Before (120 B):

> - governed 面同含 `AGENTS.md` + `CLAUDE.md`;agent 指令文件跨仓同判,仓集读 `GOVERNED_REPOS`,此处不列。

After (119 B):

> - governed 面同含 `AGENTS.md` + `CLAUDE.md`;`GOVERNED_REPOS` 各仓同治理待遇,执行席恒随落地仓车道。

Payment: in place, line-neutral — 812 / 812 before and after, 1 insertion / 1 deletion, no second line, no re-wrap, no deletion elsewhere.

What the new line says, half by half:

- 「`GOVERNED_REPOS` 各仓同治理待遇」 — every repository in `GOVERNED_REPOS` gets the same governance treatment: draft PR, human merge or authorized approval, no seat landing. 「治理待遇」 is the term the triage routing on #17163 used for exactly this half, and it is what `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` enforces (its register comment: 「The register is repo-agnostic: it applies in all of `GOVERNED_REPOS`」).
- 「执行席恒随落地仓车道」 — the execution seat always follows the lane of the repository where the edit lands. Read with the multi-repo rules already in the file (:192 multi-lane repos: central triage is the only producer of `domain:*`; :193 「单车道仓 `repo:*` 席自理机械三务,⛔ 不产 `domain:*`」; :207 「规则 1:issue 住在修复落地的仓」), a `CLAUDE.md` edit landing in `cloud` is governed AND belongs to the `repo:cloud` seat with no `domain:skills`, while one landing in objectstack stays `domain:skills` by the domain table. Reading (ii) — the lane travelling — is excluded by 「恒随落地仓车道」.

What the 「仓集读 `GOVERNED_REPOS`,此处不列」 pointer became: the repository set is still named only by the constant (`GOVERNED_REPOS` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`) and still not enumerated in SKILL.md — the constant moved from a trailing pointer to the subject of the treatment clause. The 「agent 指令文件」 subject was generalised to the whole governed face, because the audit script applies the whole register per repository, not only the two root instruction files; the two files stay named in the line, which `check:pm-governed-prose` requires.

Not touched, measured: `references/core-rules.md` :55 「多车道仓的域标签、type、定级与查重只由中央分诊生产,单车道仓自理三务不产域标签。」 states the LANE rule (who produces `domain:*`), not the governed-treatment rule — it is one of the two premises reading (i) rests on, not a restatement of the ambiguous half, so it is not a twin. 151 / 151, byte-identical. The domain table row (:249), the multi-repo section (:188–:212), `AGENTS.md` and every other reference file are untouched.

## Why

Two 细则 gave different lanes for an agent instruction file in a single-lane repository: the domain table sends the whole governed face to `domain:skills`; the multi-repo rules forbid `domain:*` on a single-lane repo's card. #17163 carried both `repo:cloud` and `domain:skills` for seven days while each seat pointed at the other; the triage seat's routing then applied reading (i) without the text saying so. This line makes that reading the written one, consistent with the card-home ruling (#17288, landed) and with that routing precedent. #17163 remains open as a coordination card; #17165 is not addressed here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:pm-dispatch SKILL.md 里「governed 面」定义的一行(第 607 行)原文是「agent 指令文件跨仓同判,仓集读 `GOVERNED_REPOS`,此处不列」,改成「`GOVERNED_REPOS` 各仓同治理待遇,执行席恒随落地仓车道」。只改这一行,行数 812 / 812 不变,120 B → 119 B。

**为什么改**:原句的「跨仓同判」有两种读法——(一)治理待遇跟着文件走(draft PR、人工或授权批准、席位不落地),执行席仍是落地仓的席;(二)车道跟着文件走,objectstack 的 skills 席去改每个仓的指令文件。读法(二)与「单车道仓 ⛔ 不产 `domain:*`」和「issue 住在修复落地的仓」两条冲突。#17163 因此同时挂了 `repo:cloud` 与 `domain:skills`,两个席位各指对方,卡在队列里七天没人能执行;分诊席按读法(一)路由后立了本卡。本 PR 把读法(一)写成文本,与卡片归属裁决(#17288)和分诊路由一致。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:规则层受管面,只动一行定义;不加标签、不加扫描、不动域表与多仓段。若维护者更倾向读法(二),回滚就是恢复原行(revert 单提交),零副作用。代价:objectui 这类多车道仓的 governed 面归属本行不新增裁定,仍按域表与 objectui 三流规则走。

**席位意见**:(留空)

**你要做的**:确认读法(一)即人工合并本 PR(或授权批准后由 skills 席落地);倾向读法(二)则驳回,本席另起。
